title: feat(pr-submit): apply the authoringLanguage policy to PR body prose
body:
## Background

Blocked by #1981

#1981 adds the `authoringLanguage` config field to
`schemas/policy.schema.json`, but no instruction file reads it yet.
`idd-template/.github/instructions/idd-pr-submit.instructions.md` (and
its lite variant) currently gives no language guidance for the PR body
it drafts, so the language it ends up in is whatever the executing
agent defaults to. This issue is blocked by #1981 because documenting a
consumer's behavior against a config field that does not exist yet
would describe unshipped behavior in the present tense.

This repository is the source of a reusable IDD distribution:
`idd-template/.github/instructions/idd-pr-submit.instructions.md` and
`idd-template/.github/instructions/lite/idd-pr-submit-lite.instructions.md`
are the canonical sources; the repo-root
`.github/instructions/idd-pr-submit.instructions.md` and its lite copy
are generated targets (`audit/sync-manifest.json` pairs
`idd-pr-submit-instructions` / `idd-pr-submit-lite-instructions`, mode
`exact`). Edit the `idd-template/` copies, never the generated targets,
per `docs/customization.md`'s "Exception: this repository is the source
of a reusable IDD distribution" section.

## Proposed change

- In both
  `idd-template/.github/instructions/idd-pr-submit.instructions.md` and
  `idd-template/.github/instructions/lite/idd-pr-submit-lite.instructions.md`,
  add guidance that the PR body's prose sections follow the resolved
  `authoringLanguage` value from `.github/idd/config.json`: a fixed
  language tag when configured, the claimed issue's own body language
  when the value is `match-source`, and English when the field is
  absent.
- Restate the same marker/footer carve-out defined in #1981: any
  machine-parsed marker or exact-regex-matched visible line always
  stays in its canonical form, unaffected by `authoringLanguage`.
- Regenerate the two generated targets
  (`.github/instructions/idd-pr-submit.instructions.md` and
  `.github/instructions/lite/idd-pr-submit-lite.instructions.md`) from
  the edited canonical sources using `pnpm run docs:sync` (`node
  scripts/sync-docs.mjs --apply`). Do not hand-edit the generated
  targets directly.

## Acceptance criteria

- Both canonical `idd-template/` instruction files describe the
  `authoringLanguage` behavior for PR body prose, consistent with
  #1981's field definition, including the marker/footer carve-out.
- `node scripts/sync-docs.mjs --check` and `node scripts/audit-docs.mjs
  --check` pass, confirming the generated `.github/instructions/`
  targets match the edited canonical sources.
- `pnpm run lint:minimum` passes.

## Candidate files

- `idd-template/.github/instructions/idd-pr-submit.instructions.md`
- `idd-template/.github/instructions/lite/idd-pr-submit-lite.instructions.md`
- `.github/instructions/idd-pr-submit.instructions.md` (regenerated, not hand-edited)
- `.github/instructions/lite/idd-pr-submit-lite.instructions.md` (regenerated, not hand-edited)
